title: SDD apply — cli
content:
Envy CLI on `darkfactory/cli/maker` covers all 15 acceptance scenarios; `go test ./...` passes.

### Commands
`list` · `check` (`--ci`) · `doctor` · `diff` · `run` · `get`/`set`/`delete` · `import`/`export` (`--reveal`) · `agent grant`/`revoke`

Secrets stay redacted by default. Agent writes use `--as-agent` and require an active grant (TTL-enforced via injectable clock). Mutations (ok/denied) append to `.envy/audit.jsonl` without plaintext secrets. Grant display uses `read_values` (denied by default).

### Follow-ups this pass
- Added `Project.SetClock` + `TestAgentGrantExpiresAndDeniesWrite` for scenario 13 expiry.
- Hardened `TestDoctorHealthyScore` assertions; aligned grant UI label with `read_values`.

### Code review

## Standards
- Hard: a few CLI command funcs >50 lines; audit persist errors still swallowed (`_ = persistAuditLocked`).
- Judgement: flag-parsing duplication; `cli_ops.go` is a change hotspot.

## Spec
- All 15 scenarios have working paths + acceptance tests (including grant TTL expiry).
- Partials: doctor gitignore is **warn** when `.git` is absent; bare `check` targets active env (development).

**Summary:** Standards ~4 (size/persist); Spec ~2 non-blocking partials. Worst Standards: swallowed audit persist. Worst Spec: none blocking.
